# pbs_acme_challenge_schema (Data Source)

Reads the DNS APIs that ACME DNS plugins of a Proxmox Backup Server can use — the `api` of `pbs_acme_plugin` — with the settings PBS documents for each, the keys of the plugin's `data`. PBS takes them from the acme.sh plugins it ships (the libproxmox-acme-plugins package), and its web interface builds its plugin form from them, so the list follows that package's version.

Most APIs document no settings: their `fields` are empty, and acme.sh's documentation of the API says what it reads. Where fields are documented, `optional` is a hint, not a rule: Cloudflare's fields are all marked required, though it takes either a token or a global key. Any user may read the schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_acme_challenge_schema" "dns" {}

variable "dns_api" {
  description = "acme.sh DNS API of the plugin, such as cf for Cloudflare."
  type        = string
  default     = "cf"
}

variable "dns_settings" {
  description = "Settings of the DNS API, such as CF_Token."
  type        = map(string)
  sensitive   = true
}

locals {
  dns_fields = try(data.pbs_acme_challenge_schema.dns.apis[var.dns_api].fields, {})
}

# A DNS plugin whose API and settings are checked against what PBS documents
# for the API: a typo in a setting's name fails the plan instead of the next
# certificate order. APIs that document no settings accept any.
resource "pbs_acme_plugin" "dns" {
  id   = "dns"
  api  = var.dns_api
  data = var.dns_settings

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = contains(keys(data.pbs_acme_challenge_schema.dns.apis), var.dns_api)
      error_message = "PBS has no DNS API ${var.dns_api}."
    }
    precondition {
      condition     = length(local.dns_fields) == 0 || alltrue([for key in keys(var.dns_settings) : contains(keys(local.dns_fields), key)])
      error_message = "dns_settings has a setting the DNS API ${var.dns_api} does not document: see the keys of its fields."
    }
  }
}

# The settings Cloudflare's API documents, with their descriptions.
output "cloudflare_settings" {
  value = {
    for key, field in data.pbs_acme_challenge_schema.dns.apis["cf"].fields : key => field.description
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `apis` (Attributes Map) The DNS APIs, by the name `api` of `pbs_acme_plugin` takes, such as `cf`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apis))

<a id="nestedatt--apis"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apis`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Hint on the settings, such as which of them go together; null when there is none.
- `fields` (Attributes Map) The settings PBS documents, by the key `data` of `pbs_acme_plugin` takes, such as `CF_Token`; empty when it documents none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apis--fields))
- `name` (String) Display name, such as `Cloudflare Managed DNS`; the API's name when PBS gives none.
- `type` (String) Challenge type of the API: `dns`.

<a id="nestedatt--apis--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apis.fields`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String) Value acme.sh uses when the setting is left out, as text, such as `120`; null when there is none.
- `description` (String) What the setting is; null when there is no description.
- `label` (String) Display name of the setting; null when it is the key.
- `optional` (Boolean) Whether the schema marks the setting optional — a hint, see above.
- `type` (String) Type of the value: `string` or `integer`; null when the schema says none.
